cases.selection_rule: supported units with at most 1,500 labels, ordered by SHA-256 of the unit id, first 12; exposed development data, units share scenes and detectors, not held out

comparison_semantics: preserved-base additions under the additive loss, unit penalties, equal frame weights, strict improvement above 1/10

families.deletion: whole-object deletion, unbounded count, one finite world
families.localization: closed reference balls of radius 0.5 m, strict 2 m rule, independent-flip relaxation for the certificate, residual radius on answers

query_unit: one reference record: deletion asks presence; localization asks centre and residual radius
answer_source: retained benchmark labels as a declared computational oracle: present, centre = retained centre; residual radius 0 (exact-adjacency oracle) and 0.25 m (declared residual) as two variants for localization
stopping_obligation: first solver-tier certificate (deletion: sufficient; localization: robust) at the declared budget; same checker for every selector; certificates recorded with solver status and time

cheap_proofs_before_search.deletion: sound tier: every unconfirmed edge-bearing label removes at most one unit, capped by gain; if it certifies, no MILP is run that round
cheap_proofs_before_search.localization: sound tier (Engine-style envelope): every unconfirmed flip removes at most one unit, capped by gain

costs_recorded: queries until first checked decision (all earlier queries counted)
baseline_for_win_loss: strongest applicable conventional selector on that case (fewest queries among random, degree/boundary_first, addition_adjacent, influence)
